proposed_rules.trigger: A content page whose body is a [2x1] split of a wide primary text column and a narrower secondary column (sidebar: author box, related links, CTA, TOC).
proposed_rules.decision: Map the primary column as default-content (headings, paragraphs, images in flow). Map the sidebar as its own block placed in the same section; EDS layout/CSS handles the two-column presentation. Do NOT emit the whole [2x1] as a single block.
proposed_rules.rationale: The two-column split is layout, not a content unit. Sidebar contents are a reusable block; the article is plain authorable content.

provenance.evidence: C36 rc1c2c2 [2x1] article+sidebar; recurs on blog-post and case-study bodies

notes: Pure case-study cluster with the canonical layout: header + two-column body. Distinct from C03's case studies that merged into template-detail — worth a spot-check on why those 3 differ. The two-column-with-sidebar pattern is generic and high-frequency (also underlies the blog-post cluster C01).
